nom: Sun Bum Original Face and Body Stick SPF 40

segments.oily: Reviewers who mention having oily skin report the stick can leave a slightly oily feel on the face, though one reviewer with oily skin found it added less oiliness than other sunscreens they had tried.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no clogged pores, breakouts, or irritation when using it on the face; one reviewer with a sensitive face avoided facial use only because of the added fragrance.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes the stick as working well for normal skin types.

concerns.redness: Reviewers frequently report no reaction, redness, or irritation on the face or body after use, including on darker and sensitive skin tones.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report the stick does not clog pores or cause breakouts; one reviewer with acne-prone skin chose to keep it to body use as a precaution rather than because of a bad reaction.
concerns.oiliness: Early reviewers describe the stick as heavy, greasy, or leaving a shiny finish on the face, while most later reviewers instead report a lightweight, non-greasy feel with no added shine.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the stick as hydrating rather than drying on the skin.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a greasy or heavy finish
Blends in without a white cast
Small amount of product for the price

extraits.titre: Not my favorite but would work if nothing else was
extraits.texte: This sunscreen immediately frustrated me as it arrived defective and would not roll up making it very difficult to use. Once I was able to scoop some out to apply, the texture left on my skin was very heavy and greasy. It does appear clear on the skin which is nice but having my hair sticking to my face because the wind blew and it stuck the sunscreen was a major ick for me.

I like the convenience of the stick format , but I wasn't a fan of how it felt on my face. It leaves a very greasy and shiny finish that feel heavy on my skin. I was hoping for something more lightweight, specifically for everyday use. It works better for the body, but for facial application it was much too oily.

This was my first time trying a sunscreen in stick form, and it did not disappoint! The packaging is very convenience and avoids getting your hands dirty for application. The sunscreen glides on like butter and feels moisturizing. It made my face slightly oily, but I do already have oily skin. Compared to other products it did not make my skin overly oily. It definitely provided good sun protection. The sunscreen also smelled like a coconut and banana mix, perfect for summer days! It's my newest addition to my must haves on the go bag I carry on the daily. I would highly recommend for the convenience.

This sunscreen stick has quickly become one of my favorite beach bag and everyday essentials! ☀️💛 the application is so easy – just swipe and go. It glides on smoothly without feeling greasy, heavy or sticky, which is a huge win for me. I love that it's compact enough to toss in my purse or beach tote for quick touchups throughout the day. It's also super kid friendly making sunscreen re-application much less of a struggle when we're out and about. The SPF 40 protection hold up really well even during long days outside and I appreciate that it's water resistant. As someone with sensitive skin I'm always cautious with sunscreen products but this one does not clog my pores or cause any breakouts or irritation. For the quality and convenience I absolutely recommend this product. I love it! 🏖️

extraits.titre: Great for small touch ups on body
extraits.texte: This Sun screen stick is advertised as a face and body stick, and while it can be used on both it has a shiny/white cast residue so I would only use it on my body (hence the 4 stars). It works great and I used it several times already this summer mostly to touch up spots like my scalp, shoulders, neck, etc. but would not use it on my face! I have acne prone skin though so that's why. I did receive this from Influenster to review and that's my Honest opinion! Like all products from this brand it smells great and not like sunscreen which I do love, but definitely don't want to use it on my face :)

The sun bum is an effective broad spectrum sunscreen that provides solid SPF 40 protection against UVA and UVB rays, especially when applied generously and evenly, though its stick format works best for targeted areas rather than full body coverage. It suitable for beach or outdoors use, but still requires regular reapplication. In terms of of compatibility, it works well for normal skin types but may feel greasy on oily skin and could irritate sensitive skin due to its noticeable coconut like fragrance and chemical filters. It's a convenient portable option ideal for quick reapplication on the go
